## Deviations (recorded, not smoothed)

1. **A stray separator text node would break SIG-UI-091 parity.** The
   copy element's first draft appended a bare `" "` sibling beside the
   `[data-enhancement]` button — outside the marker, so JS-on `main`
   text differed on every T1 route (31-route red). The fix: no text
   nodes beside chrome; spacing is the stylesheet's (`margin-inline`).
   The parity spec is the enforcement that caught it.
2. **The zero-script assertions aged into the wrong contract.** Three
   specs asserted a literal `count == 0` on T1 pages — true while the
   allow-list was empty, wrong under UXK0-4. They now assert the
   ADR-155 contract (module type + allow-listed src) — the same
   semantic the playwright `script-policy` sweep enforces, extended
   into the Python composed stack.
3. **ADR-224's `Supersedes:` field named ADR-155 in prose.** The
   declaration checker reads every `ADR-NNN` token in the field as a
   supersession target and demanded a `Superseded by` status line on
   ADR-155 — wrong: ADR-224 supersedes nothing (ADR-155's contract is
   deliberately unchanged). The mention moved out of the field value;
   no status line written.
4. **`is:inline` on the module tags.** Astro would otherwise try to
   process/bundle the `/_kit/` `src`; `is:inline` emits the tag
   verbatim — the emitted entry the allow-list names is the one the
   build hook wrote.
5. **The fixture cite is `unreleased`-mode.** The harness mounts
   `<sig-cite>` on fixture markup whose citation mode lacks the
   `cite-sentence` element the first e2e draft asserted; assertions
   follow the rendered model (static citation + permalink), never a
   fixture the build doesn't emit.
6. **`_kit` in `ops/public_routes.toml`, the harness route not.** The
   kit modules are public assets; the harness is a build-time test
   surface injected only by `SIG_BUILD_INTERNAL=1` — the allow-list
   records the asset prefix, not the route.

## Fix arc (recorded)

1. **Parity red on every T1 route → drop the stray separator node** —
   `sig-copy` appended a bare `" "` outside the `[data-enhancement]`
   subtree; JS-on `main` text carried an extra space on all 31 T1
   routes. Removed the node; spacing moved to `margin-inline`
   (Deviation 1).
2. **`toHaveCount(0)` on `<script>` → allow-list assertion** — the
   jurisdiction + watch-evidence no-js specs and the two composed-stack
   legs asserted the pre-UXK0-4 contract; rewritten as
   module-type + `t1-module-entries.json` membership (Deviation 2).
3. **Fixture-mode citation assertions** — the e2e expected
   `cite-sentence` on an `unreleased`-mode fixture and an unscoped
   option query matched the format select's `<option>`s; assertions
   respelled against the rendered model and the typeahead listbox
   (Deviation 5).
4. **`check:paths` +1 counted site** — a literal `"/enhancement-kit/"`
   in the harness → `withBase()`; containment baseline held.
5. **ADR-224 un-supersedes ADR-155** — the `Supersedes:` field's prose
   mention demanded a phantom status line on ADR-155; the mention
   left the field value (Deviation 3).
6. **Stale `BACKLOG.md`** — the BL-086 registration in `BACKLOG.csv`
   made the rendered markdown stale; regenerated with
   `build_backlog_md.py`, never hand-edited.
7. **`ruff format` reflow** — one assertion helper reflowed
